who_decides: Every word below is a draft for Ryan (and the attorney for the privacy and terms text). Nothing is submitted until Ryan says so.
name: Ryagram
one_liner: Turn data into a short film: create a project, write the film's story, preview it, and change its look in your open editor, with your own Claude.
description: Ryagram makes short, accurate data films. This connector lets your AI work on your own Ryagram projects: list them, read the story format and the dataset catalogue, write and check a story, ask for a contact sheet or a short preview, and (with a separate permission) change the look and the clip list in the editor you have open, as drafts you can undo. It can write down a plan to download a public data file, but only you can start that download, in the Ryagram desktop app. It can never render the final film, spend your credits, publish anything or fetch a web address on its own: those stay your buttons in the Ryagram app. Sign in with your Ryagram account; you choose which permissions to give and can disconnect at any time in Account > Connected AIs.

server.auth: OAuth 2.0 (authorization code, PKCE S256, dynamic client registration, rotating refresh tokens)
server.tools: see tools.json (generated from the live tool list; tools/connect-directory.mjs --check keeps it honest)
server.blocker: G1: the address is a supabase.co function URL. Decide the custom domain (the paper suggests mcp.uselai.com) BEFORE the first submission; for OpenAI the origin may never change afterwards.

use_cases: Describe a film in plain words and have your AI write the story, check it against Ryagram's rules and save it.
Ask for a contact sheet or a 10-second preview of the saved story and get the link to watch it.
Ask your AI to change colours and styles, or reorder clips, in the editor you have open, and undo it.
before_you_connect: A Ryagram account that has been invited to connect an AI (invite-only for now). You sign in on Ryagram's own page and choose the permissions.

data_handling.what_the_assistant_can_read: Project titles, film stories, job states, and only if the person ticks it, the names and times in an editor's clip list.
data_handling.what_it_cannot_see: The person's videos, pictures, sound, file locations, credit history or payment details.
data_handling.what_ryagram_keeps: A log of each call: the tool name, the credits involved, whether it worked and a short code. Not the arguments, the story text or the conversation.
data_handling.tokens: Stored only as one-way hashes; revocable in Account > Connected AIs.

test_account.needed: One reviewer account, invited to connect an AI, with a project, a saved story and a finished contact sheet. Created by Ryan.
test_account.credentials: IN THE VENDOR PORTAL ONLY (never in this repository, the board or a log)
test_account.sign_in_note: Verify the sign-in works with no email code or magic link before submitting (paper G5).

not_accepted_check: None of Anthropic's excluded categories applies: no money or crypto, no image/video/audio generation through AI models, no access to Claude memory or chats, no use of another service's API.
open_items_for_ryan: Approve or change the words above.
Decide the custom domain (G1) and the invite wall (G10).
Make the Connect your AI page public and link it (G6; today it is noindex).
Create and fill the reviewer account (G5); enter its credentials in the portal only.
